Container.Name: gridcraft-web
Container.Overview: GridCraft Web is a community-maintained Docker image that serves GridCraft, a spreadsheet application written in Rust, through a browser-based WebAssembly interface. The upstream application supports spreadsheet workflows and workbook formats including XLSX, CSV, and TSV. Workbooks are opened and saved through browser file handling; the container only serves the static web application and does not provide centralized workbook storage or server-side spreadsheet processing.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: GridCraft Grid Craft Spreadsheet Spreadsheet Editor XLSX Excel CSV TSV Workbook Browser WebAssembly WASM
Container.Requires: No special privileges, database, or persistent data volumes are required for the standard deployment. Workbooks are handled by the browser application using browser file picker and download capabilities. The container serves HTTP on port 8080. Use HTTPS through a reverse proxy for remote access where required by browser security restrictions.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: Host port used to access the GridCraft Web interface. The container listens on port 8080.
